subject: CloudHarbor onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudharbor.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@cloudharbor.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding & temporary no-PO ask — CloudHarbor trial

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to kick off a 3-month pilot of Redwood inference for our product search assistant. Legal and procurement at CloudHarbor are a bit backlogged — they asked whether Redwood can accept invoices for this pilot without a PO for the initial 90-day trial.

Quick context: this is a low-cost, usage-based pilot (~$4–6k total expected), billed monthly. Our finance team wants to avoid a long PO setup to move faster.

I've attached a completed W-9 and a short pilot statement that describes scope and estimated spend. Also attaching a SOC2 scan summary; our security folks will cooperate with any follow-ups.

Attachments: [Attachment: CloudHarbor_W9.pdf (form)], [Attachment: pilot_statement.docx (doc)], [Attachment: SOC2_scan_summary.pdf (report)]

Would Redwood consider a temporary invoice-only path for the pilot with conditions (e.g., 90-day limit, pre-approved spend cap, and payment within net 30)? If so, what's the approval process and who needs to sign off on Redwood's side?

Appreciate it — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships, CloudHarbor
samir@cloudharbor.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding & temporary no-PO ask — CloudHarbor trial

Hi Samir — thanks for the materials and the clear ask. I handle procurement intake for trials, so happy to coordinate. A few items we need to proceed before I can approve a temporary no-PO path: 

1) Confirmed billing contact and invoicing email (you included billing@cloudharbor.com but please confirm receiver name).
2) Signed temporary terms from Redwood (I can prepare a short addendum).
3) Evidence: W-9 (received), SOC2 summary (received) — our risk team may request a 3rd-party scan report if anything is ambiguous.
4) Spend cap you request for the 90-day window (please provide a hard number).

Process note: Temporary invoice-only exceptions require procurement + finance sign-off for anything over $5k. For <$5k we can generally grant a low-touch allowance; between $5k–$15k we require a short approval chain; above that we need FP&A sign-off.

Next steps from you: please reply with the billing contact name and the explicit spend cap. I will then loop in Neha (procurement director) for the formal exception and draft the addendum.

If Marissa has any commercial commitments to share (discounts, evaluation SLAs), please include.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot onboarding & temporary no-PO ask — CloudHarbor trial

Looping in Neha since this is time-sensitive. CloudHarbor is a priority inbound — they're ready to start next week and the sales-led pilot converts fast if we can remove the onboarding friction.

Samir — to be transparent, I committed to a start date of 8/30 during the product walkthrough. The pilot spend estimate is accurate (we were expecting ~5k first-month). If procurement can greenlight a temporary invoice-only route, we'll convert quickly to a paid account.

Key asks for Procurement: 
- 90-day exception with a $6k total cap (CloudHarbor's ask — Samir, can you confirm?)
- Net 30 payment terms, invoices to billing@cloudharbor.com (with contact: Priya Rao, Billing Lead)
- Short addendum (no long SOW) — ML/usage-based billing only

Neha — is there an expedited path for pilots under $10k that doesn't require FP&A? If so, can we use a pre-approved temporary terms doc and a signed email confirmation?

Marissa

Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding & temporary no-PO ask — CloudHarbor trial

Hi all — reviewed the thread and the attachments. We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding exception under these conditions: 

- Term: 90 days from the execution of the temporary addendum.
- Spend cap: $6,000 total for the pilot period.
- Payment: Net 30 from invoice date; invoices must be sent to billing@cloudharbor.com and copy to priya.rao@cloudharbor.com.
- Required signed docs: the temporary addendum (attached as temporary_terms.docx) and a confirmation email from CloudHarbor billing lead.
- Risk controls: Redwood reserves the right to pause access if invoices are >45 days overdue. Any data access tied to commercial features will be limited until cleared.

Samir — I'm attaching the short addendum and a DocuSign link for signature. Please have Priya sign and return before the first invoice is issued. Once signed, Irene will process the exception and route invoicing instructions to our finance ledger.

Attachments: [Attachment: temporary_terms.docx (doc)]
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ123TEMP
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (Deal: DEAL-CHB-2026-08)

Thanks — Neha
